"""The two hard preconditions of TEST evaluation in METRIX E1-PILOT: ST10 from committed records, and "TEST is
evaluated once".

Protocol v1.1 section 8 step 8 (freeze record -> test_qa.jsonl, general_test.jsonl -> L3-L5 on TEST -> L6 TEST part by
the Executor and by the data-auditor, results must agree -> ST10 -> TEST evaluated once), section 3 (L6 TEST part),
section 11 ST10. Owner's stage-C message (tasks/IMPL_C_OWNER_MESSAGE.md): stage-B ruling item 7 and Review Gate
supplementary rulings 3-5 of 2026-11-24. Review Gate's ruling on C1 of 2026-11-25 (tasks/IMPL_C1_RULING.md, "C1
ruling" below).

What the gates guard against (C1 ruling): an Executor who follows the rules and the RUNBOOK evaluating TEST twice by
accident, or evaluating TEST while ST10 does not hold. Deliberate tampering by someone with write access to the
repository (rewritten history, forged records) is left to GitHub's branch protection and the review records.

The pilot's checkout (check_checkout; C1 ruling 1). Every TEST path runs in a clone whose remote PILOT_REMOTE is the
pilot's repository (CANONICAL_REPO: the owner/name of its fetch URL; the host is not compared), with PILOT_BRANCH
checked out, not shallow, and HEAD equal to the latest commit of PILOT_BRANCH on the remote, fetched now; otherwise
BLOCKED. A record "exists" when it is in the working tree or in the file tree of that latest commit; no other commit,
ref, reflog entry or tag is searched (C1 ruling 1). On GitHub the branch refuses force-pushes and deletion and accepts
direct pushes (C1 ruling 6; RUNBOOK_A100.md).

The commit and push preconditions (check_commit_preconditions; C1 ruling 2), checked before the ST10 record, the
marker or the result is written: the pilot's checkout, nothing staged, a committer identity, `git push --dry-run`
accepted. commit_paths then commits exactly the record's path and pushes it (no tags, no force) and checks the remote
ref. A push the remote still refuses (a dry run runs no server-side hook) is BLOCKED; the record stays in the working
tree and refuses the step again.

ST10 record, results/st10_record.json, written by the step 8 TEST driver (test_data.main) right after the TEST files and
the TEST part of the leakage checks (st10_record, write_st10_record):
    kind "st10", mode "formal", label null, frozen_commit, authorization {gate0_record_sha256,
    selection_record_sha256}, test_files_sha256 {test_qa.jsonl, general_test.jsonl}, code_commit (HEAD when the TEST
    files were generated; the package and run_pilot.py had no uncommitted change: checked before generation), counts
    {L3a, L3b, L4, L5, L6}: the raw counts of the TEST part, no limit, no flag, no result word.
    Before it generates anything the driver checks the commit and push preconditions and refuses when an ST10 record
    exists (refuse_if_st10_record: TEST is generated once); afterwards it commits and pushes the record. A push refused
    after generation: TEST counts as generated, no second run (the record in the working tree refuses it), BLOCKED,
    report to the Owner, who decides whether this one file is committed by hand (C1 ruling 2).
data-auditor's count, audit/st10_l6_test_count.json, written by the data-auditor with its own script and committed:
    kind "st10_auditor_l6", frozen_commit, general_test_sha256 (of the file it counted), l6_test_count (integer).
ST10 gate (st10_check), before the TEST evaluation starts and again before every TEST evaluation call: both files are
committed (HEAD blob = working tree); the record is bound to the TestAuthorization (frozen commit, the two record
hashes) and to the TEST rows about to be evaluated (their sha256); its code commit is an ancestor of HEAD; every count
is an integer, re-judged against the frozen limit (SPLIT_MANIFEST.json, leakage._rules) by stops.st10; the
data-auditor's file names the same general_test.jsonl and its count must equal the Executor's L6 count (stops.st10).
A missing or unbound record refuses the TEST path (ImplementationFail, as leakage.verify_authorization); a count over
its limit or two different L6 counts stop with ST10 (BLOCKED, report to the Owner).

TEST evaluated once, marker results/test_evaluation_marker.json:
  - begin_test_evaluation refuses while a marker or a result exists (refuse_if_marker). Otherwise it checks the
    authorization, the ST10 gate and the commit and push preconditions, writes the marker (frozen commit,
    authorization, remote URL and branch, sha256 of the ST10 record and of the data-auditor's count, TEST file hashes,
    every checkpoint hash of the committed freeze record plus N, the models TEST evaluates, code commit, a random
    session id), commits that one path, pushes it, and only then returns the TestSession. A commit or push that fails
    after the marker was written is BLOCKED. After the push, the pushed commit must hold this marker's bytes and its
    parent no marker; otherwise another begin ran at the same time (e.g. the same command started twice in one clone):
    BLOCKED, it counts as evaluated (round-1 code review of the C1 second submission, MAJOR 2).
  - evaluate.evaluate_model(split="test") calls require_test_session (no claim), then evaluate.require_gpu, then
    claim_checkpoint, then the scorers. require_test_session: the session was returned by begin_test_evaluation in
    this process; PILOT_BRANCH is checked out at the marker commit, so the committed marker and records are the
    ones begin checked and wrote (when begin returned, the marker commit was the remote branch's latest commit: begin
    fetched and compared before writing and checked the pushed ref after; the calls do not fetch again); the TEST
    rows are the files of the marker; the ST10 gate holds for them; the checkpoint is one of the marker's models not
    yet claimed in the session; the model's state sha256 (train.state_sha256, interpretation B25) is the marker's
    hash of that checkpoint.
  - finish_test_evaluation, once every model was claimed: the checkout still at the marker commit, the commit and
    push preconditions, then it commits and pushes results/test_evaluation_result.json; the session ends.
  - A marker without a result: the evaluation started and did not finish; it counts as evaluated; BLOCKED; report to
    the Owner. A result (with or without a marker): TEST was evaluated (TestAlreadyEvaluated).
Statuses of the refusals (C1 ruling 4): caused by the environment (the checkout, the fetch, staged changes, the commit
and push preconditions, a commit or push that fails) BLOCKED; a missing or unbound record, a model whose state hash is
not the marker's, a second TEST generation, a failing git command that reads the repository ImplementationFail;
TestAlreadyEvaluated carries no section 9 status. URLs are written and reported without user information
(credentials). Python cannot stop other code from writing these files or building these objects; the checks hold for
the package's own paths.
"""
import json
import re
import secrets
import subprocess
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from . import data as D
from . import frozen as FZ
from . import leakage as LK
from . import record as R
from . import stops as STP
from .errors import ImplementationFail, ProtocolStop

ST10_RECORD_REL = R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL + "/st10_record.json"
AUDITOR_L6_REL = FZ.PILOT_REL + "/audit/st10_l6_test_count.json"
MARKER_REL = R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL + "/test_evaluation_marker.json"
RESULT_REL = R.FORMAL_RESULTS_REL + "/test_evaluation_result.json"
CODE_PATHS = (FZ.PILOT_REL + "/src", FZ.PILOT_REL + "/run_pilot.py")
BASE_MODEL = "N"
HEX40 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
CANONICAL_REPO = "leotree2020/OpenMythos"            # protocol section 0, base repository
PILOT_REMOTE = "origin"                                # the clone's remote that points at it (RUNBOOK_A100.md)
PILOT_BRANCH = "metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1"           # metrix/CLAUDE.md section 2
_USERINFO = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://)[^/@\s]*@")


class TestAlreadyEvaluated(Exception):
    """TEST was evaluated (marker and result exist): any further TEST evaluation is refused. Carries no section 9
    status: the pilot's status is the one of its result."""
    __test__ = False        # not a pytest test class


def _git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


def _blob(root, spec):
    """The bytes of the blob `spec` (<commit>:<path>), or None when there is none."""
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "cat-file", "blob", spec], capture_output=True, check=False)
    return r.stdout if r.returncode == 0 else None


def _refuse(message):
    return ImplementationFail("TEST path refused: %s" % message)


def scrub(text):
    """`text` without the user information of any URL in it (https://user:token@host/... -> https://host/...)."""
    return _USERINFO.sub(r"\1", text)


def _blocked(message):
    return ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", scrub("TEST path refused: %s; report to the Owner" % message))


def _count(v):
    return type(v) is int and v >= 0

    every command but smoke builds the formal mode, and a formal pilot on the CPU stops with ST8 before anything is
    generated, written or committed;

    raised; the work directory is never inside the repository;

  - the model directory is checked against the frozen revision;

def run_pilot_module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("run_pilot_under_test", RUN_PILOT)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def git(root, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError("git %s: %s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout.strip()


def shared_clone(fz, tmp_path):
    """A clone of this repository under tmp_path (objects shared, so the frozen commit is there; the checkout is
    HEAD's tree), its origin set to a path that is no repository: a formal Pilot on it cannot write into this clone or
    reach the pilot's remote."""
    root = tmp_path / "repo"
    git(tmp_path, "clone", "-q", "--shared", str(fz.repo_root), str(root))
    git(root, "remote", "set-url", "origin", str(tmp_path / "no-remote.git"))
    return root

def test_every_checkpoint_reloads_with_the_same_state_hash(inputs_dir, tmp_path, generated):
    p = P.Pilot(M.smoke_mode(2), inputs_dir, tmp_path / "w", "cpu")
    D.write(generated["files"], p.data_dir)
    p.load_data()
    base_sha = T.state_sha256(p.base_model())
    assert T.state_sha256(p.base_model()) == base_sha                # every run starts from the same weights
    for arm in ("F", "L", "A"):
        spec = T.search_runs(p.contract, arm)[0]
        model = p.base_model()
        T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, p.mode, p.device)
        trained = T.state_sha256(model)
        reloaded, info = p.save_checkpoint(spec, model)
        assert info["state_sha256"] == info["reloaded_state_sha256"] == trained == T.state_sha256(reloaded)
        assert info["file_sha256"] == FZ.file_sha256(p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name))
        again = p.load_checkpoint(spec, p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name))
        assert T.state_sha256(again) == trained and trained != base_sha
        assert torch.load(p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name), weights_only=True)["label"] == M.SMOKE_LABEL
    assert (p.ckpt_dir / P.LABEL_FILE).is_file()
    with pytest.raises(ImplementationFail):            # a run is saved once
        p.save_checkpoint(spec, reloaded)

def write(root, rel, obj):
    path = root / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    return FZ.sha256_hex(blob)

content.content:
## 5. Metrics

**记号**:f 为 fact,a_f 为真实答案,C_f 为它的 4 个候选,Q_split(f) 为该 split 里它的问句集合,θ 为被评模型。

**闭卷候选打分(主指标)**
```
s_QA(f, q, c) = Σ_{t=1..K} log p_θ(c'_t | chat(q) + "The answer is", c'_<t)      c' = " " + c;K = K_st(c)(cell 内相同)
correct(f, q) = 1[ s_QA(f, q, a_f) > max_{c ∈ C_f, c ≠ a_f} s_QA(f, q, c) ]      并列判为错
Score_split(f) = (1 / |Q_split(f)|) · Σ_{q ∈ Q_split(f)} correct(f, q)             聚合函数 = mean(已固定)
Acc(arm, split, G) = (1 / |G|) · Σ_{f ∈ G} Score_split(f)                          G = learned 或 unread 或其中一个 stratum
```
4 选 1 的随机水平是 0.25。选 mean 的理由:保留多个问法之间的部分一致程度;统计单位仍是 fact。

**TRAIN 闭卷检查**
```
s_ST(f, c) = Σ_{t=1..K'} log p_θ(c'_t | prefix(f), c'_<t)      prefix(f) = TRAIN 陈述句中答案之前的文本,不含答案前的空格(该空格属于 c'),前面不加任何特殊 token;c' = " " + c;K' = K_st(c)(与 s_QA 的 K 相同,cell 内相同)
CB(f) = 1[ s_ST(f, a_f) > max_{c ≠ a_f} s_ST(f, c) ]
Acc_CB(arm) = (1/120) · Σ_{f ∈ learned} CB(f)
```

**Free-generation exact match(次指标)**:对 `chat(q) + "The answer is"`(与 `s_QA` 的上下文相同)做贪心解码:`do_sample=False`,每步取概率最大的 token;这一设置写死,覆盖固定 revision 的 `generation_config.json` 中的采样默认值(`do_sample` true、`temperature` 0.6、`top_k` 20、`top_p` 0.95)。最多 16 个新 token,生成出 `<|im_end|>`(id 151645)或 `<|endoftext|>`(id 151643)即停。新 token 解码成文本时跳过特殊 token(`skip_special_tokens=True`;这两个停止 token 都是特殊 token,不进入输出)。归一化之前,先删除输出中的 `<think>…</think>` 片段:从 `<think>` 到其后第一个 `</think>`(两者都含),每处都删;这两个标记(id 151667、151668)不是特殊 token,`skip_special_tokens=True` 不会去掉它们。归一化:删除 `<think>…</think>` 片段之后,先去掉开头的空白(含空格与换行),再取第一行,去首尾空白,去开头的 “the ”(不分大小写),去结尾的 `. , ; : ! ?`,casefold。`EM(f, q) = 1[norm(output) == norm(a_f)]`;聚合方式同上。

**全对率(次指标,只报告)**:`AllCorrect(f) = Π_{q} correct(f, q)`。

**General damage**
```
NLL_arm(w) = −(1/(n_w − 1)) · Σ_{t=2..n_w} log p_θ(x_t | x_<t)             w 为一个通用文本窗口
dNLL(arm) = mean_{domain} mean_{w ∈ domain} [ NLL_arm(w) − NLL_N(w) ]         主
PPL_degradation%(arm) = 100 · (exp(dNLL(arm)) − 1)                           展示
```
窗口前面不加任何特殊 token(不前置 `<|endoftext|>`);x_1 没有条件,不计分,t 从 2 起;n_w 为窗口实际送入模型的 id 序列长度:送入模型的是第 2.7 节用本协议分词器切分后截断得到的原始 id(最多 256 个),不解码再编码。

**Unread controls**(问的是真实答案;不使用 NONE 选项)
```
Prior(split) = Acc(N, split, unread)
Spill(arm, split) = Acc(arm, split, unread) − Prior(split)                    知识外溢
FPR(arm, split) = (1/40) · Σ_{f ∈ unread} AllCorrect(f)                        与 FPR(N, split) 并排报告
```
E1-PILOT 不定义 NONE / 拒答任务。

**ImmediateGain 与 Retention**
```
ImmediateGain(arm, split) = Acc(arm, split, learned) − Acc(N, split, learned)
Retention(arm) = [Acc_after_phase2(arm, learned_1) − Acc(N, learned_1)] / [Acc_after_phase1(arm, learned_1) − Acc(N, learned_1)]
                 仅当分母 ≥ 0.10 时有定义;learned_1 = 第一阶段学的 fact,phase2 = 之后在其它内容上的训练
```
E1-PILOT 只有一个训练阶段:Retention 记为 NOT_TESTED,不进任何门槛。

## 6. Statistical Plan

- **Bootstrap 单位是 fact_id,不是问句。** 同一 fact 的多个问句高度相关,把问句当作独立观测会虚增样本量、使 CI 过窄(伪重复);因此先按第 5 节聚合成 Score(f),再对 fact 重抽样。
- 配对:比较 X 与 Y 时,`d_f = Score_X(f) − Score_Y(f)`,两个 arm 使用同一批重抽到的 fact_id。
- 次数 **10,000**;在 natural、random 两个 stratum 内分别有放回重抽(保持各自的 fact 数),合并后取 `Δ* = mean(d_f)`;95% CI = 第 2.5 与第 97.5 百分位。随机数:`rng_rule(BOOTSTRAP_SEED, "<比较>:<split>:<seed 或 avg>")`。
- **比较项**:Δ(F−N)、Δ(L−F)、Δ(A−F),在 learned fact 上;另报 Δ(S−N)、Δ(Y−N) 与各 arm 的 Spill。
- **报告**:每个训练种子单独报告;再报告 seed-average(先对每条 fact 把 3 个种子的 Score 取平均,再 bootstrap)。
- 3 个种子只作为方向一致性的证据,不作强推断。
- CI 是主要的不确定性描述;不报告 p 值作为判据。
- 精度说明:120 条 fact 时,正确率在 0.5 附近的标准误不超过 0.046。

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- one evaluation

SPLIT_FILES = {"dev": ("dev_qa.jsonl", "general_dev.jsonl"), "test": ("test_qa.jsonl", "general_test.jsonl")}


def evaluate_model(model, tok, data, templates, ev, mode, device, split="dev", with_em=True, with_s_mapping=False,
                   batch_size=64, test_authorization=None, fz=None, test_session=None, checkpoint_name=None):
    """Section 5 evaluation of one model (parsed files of the data directory in `data`): QA scores of the split, the
    TRAIN closed book, EM on the split's questions, general-text NLL of the split; optionally (DEV) S's own-mapping
    accuracy. Output keys: <split>_qa, train_cb, general_<split>, em_<split>[, s_mapping_dev_qa, s_mapping_cb].
    split "test" needs test_qa.jsonl / general_test.jsonl in `data`, which only exist after the TEST generator's
    preconditions (test_data.py), and the TestAuthorization of those preconditions, checked with the frozen files `fz`
    (frozen.load) against the committed Gate 0 and freeze records before anything is evaluated
    (leakage.verify_authorization), then the two hard preconditions of TEST evaluation (testgate.require_test_session:
    the TEST session begun by this process with the committed and pushed marker, the ST10 gate from the committed
    records for these rows, `checkpoint_name` one of the marker's models not yet evaluated, and the model's state
    sha256 equal to the marker's hash of that checkpoint). Formal and preflight modes evaluate on the GPU only
    (require_gpu); a TEST checkpoint is claimed for the session only after that (testgate.claim_checkpoint), right
    before it is evaluated."""
    if split not in SPLIT_FILES:
        raise ValueError("split %r" % (split,))
    if with_s_mapping and split != "dev":           # checked before the TEST gate claims a checkpoint
        raise ValueError("S's own-mapping accuracy is reported on DEV only (protocol section 8)")
    if split == "test":
        if not mode.formal:
            raise ImplementationFail("TEST is evaluated in formal mode only (%s mode; protocol section 8 step 8: TEST "
                                     "is evaluated once)" % mode.name)
        from .leakage import verify_authorization
        if fz is None:
            raise ImplementationFail("TEST path refused: the frozen files (fz) are needed to check the authorization")
        verify_authorization(test_authorization, fz)
        from . import testgate as TG
        TG.require_test_session(fz, test_authorization, test_session, checkpoint_name, data, model)
        require_gpu(mode, device)
        TG.claim_checkpoint(test_session, checkpoint_name)
    else:
        require_gpu(mode, device)
    qa_file, gen_file = SPLIT_FILES[split]
    facts, cands, qs = data["facts.jsonl"], data["candidates.json"], data[qa_file]
    out = {"%s_qa" % split: score_qa(model, tok, qs, cands, facts, ev, device, batch_size),
           "train_cb": score_cb(model, tok, facts, cands, templates, ev, device, batch_size),
           "general_%s" % split: general_nll(model, data[gen_file], ev, device, max(1, batch_size // 4))}
    if with_em:
        out["em_%s" % split] = em(model, tok, qs, facts, ev, device, max(1, batch_size // 2))
    if with_s_mapping:
        qa, cb = score_s_mapping(model, tok, facts, cands, templates, qs, data["train_S.jsonl"], ev, device, batch_size)
        out["s_mapping_dev_qa"], out["s_mapping_cb"] = qa, cb
    return out
    session_id: str
    marker_commit: str
    evaluated: set = field(default_factory=set)


_LIVE = {}                  # session_id -> TestSession, only those returned by begin_test_evaluation in this process


def begin_test_evaluation(fz, authorization, data, base_model_sha256, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """Start the single TEST evaluation (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4): checks (no marker or result:
    refuse_if_marker; the authorization; the ST10 gate for the TEST rows in `data`; check_commit_preconditions),
    writes the marker with every checkpoint hash of the committed freeze record plus N (`base_model_sha256`,
    train.state_sha256 of the loaded base model), commits only the marker and pushes it. Returns the TestSession."""
    from . import contract as C
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    refuse_if_marker(root)
    recs = LK.verify_authorization(authorization, fz, root)
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    st10_sha, aud_sha = st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if not isinstance(base_model_sha256, str) or not FZ.HEX64.fullmatch(base_model_sha256):
        raise _refuse("base model hash %r" % (base_model_sha256,))
    freeze = recs["selection_freeze"]
    checkpoints = dict(freeze["checkpoints"], **{BASE_MODEL: base_model_sha256})
    models = evaluated_models(C.load(fz), freeze["selected"])
    check_commit_preconditions(root, "the TEST marker")
    session_id = secrets.token_hex(16)
    marker = {"kind": "test_evaluation_marker", "mode": "formal", "frozen_commit": authorization.frozen_commit,
              "authorization": auth_fields(authorization), "remote": remote_url(root, PILOT_REMOTE),
              "branch": PILOT_BRANCH, "st10_record_sha256": st10_sha, "auditor_count_sha256": aud_sha,
              "test_files_sha256": rows_hashes, "checkpoints": checkpoints, "models": models,
              "code_commit": code_commit(root), "session_id": session_id,
              "started_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    path = root / MARKER_REL
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(marker, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    head = commit_paths(root, [MARKER_REL], "metrix: E1-PILOT TEST evaluation marker (section 8 step 8: TEST is "
                        "evaluated once; every checkpoint hash)",
                        "the TEST marker (TEST not evaluated; the marker refuses any later evaluation)", retries, sleep)
    if _blob(root, "%s:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) != blob or _blob(root, "%s^:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) is not None:
        raise _blocked("the pushed commit %s does not hold this TEST marker alone (another TEST evaluation began at "
                       "the same time): it counts as evaluated; no TEST evaluation in this process" % head)
    session = TestSession(session_id, head)
    _LIVE[session_id] = session
    return session


def _check_session_checkout(root, session):
    """PILOT_BRANCH is checked out at the session's marker commit (no fetch: see the module docstring). So the
    committed marker, Gate 0, freeze and ST10 records are the ones begin_test_evaluation checked and wrote."""
    local = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    head = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "HEAD^{commit}").stdout.strip()
    if local != PILOT_BRANCH or head != session.marker_commit:
        raise _blocked("the checkout is %r at %s, not the pilot's %r at the TEST marker commit %s" % (
            local, head, PILOT_BRANCH, session.marker_commit))


def require_test_session(fz, authorization, session, checkpoint_name, data, model, repo_root=None):
    """Called by evaluate.evaluate_model(split="test") after leakage.verify_authorization and before anything is
    evaluated (see the module docstring). Claims nothing (claim_checkpoint, after the GPU check). The model's state
    sha256 is computed last, after the cheaper checks."""
    from .train import state_sha256
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    if not isinstance(session, TestSession) or _LIVE.get(session.session_id) is not session:
        raise _refuse("no TEST session of this process (begin_test_evaluation)")
    _check_session_checkout(root, session)
    marker, _ = _committed(root, MARKER_REL, "TEST marker")
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    if marker.get("test_files_sha256") != rows_hashes:
        raise _refuse("the TEST rows %r are not the files of the marker %r" % (rows_hashes,
                                                                              marker.get("test_files_sha256")))
    st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if checkpoint_name not in marker["models"]:
        raise _refuse("%r is not a model TEST evaluates (%s)" % (checkpoint_name, marker["models"]))
    if checkpoint_name in session.evaluated:
        raise _refuse("%s was already evaluated on TEST in this session" % checkpoint_name)
    got = state_sha256(model)
    if got != marker["checkpoints"][checkpoint_name]:
        raise _refuse("the model's state sha256 %s is not the marker's %s for %s" % (
            got, marker["checkpoints"][checkpoint_name], checkpoint_name))


def claim_checkpoint(session, checkpoint_name):
    """Right before the evaluation of `checkpoint_name` starts (after require_test_session and the GPU check): the
    checkpoint is evaluated at most once in the session."""
    if not isinstance(session, TestSession) or _LIVE.get(session.session_id) is not session:
        raise _refuse("no TEST session of this process (begin_test_evaluation)")
    if checkpoint_name in session.evaluated:
        raise _refuse("%s was already evaluated on TEST in this session" % checkpoint_name)
    session.evaluated.add(checkpoint_name)


def finish_test_evaluation(fz, session, result, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """After every model of the marker was claimed (PILOT_BRANCH checked out at the marker commit) and the commit and
    push preconditions hold: write `result` (the TEST results, JSON values only) to RESULT_REL, commit only that path,
    push it; the session ends."""
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    if not isinstance(session, TestSession) or _LIVE.get(session.session_id) is not session:
        raise _refuse("no TEST session of this process")
    _check_session_checkout(root, session)
    marker, _ = _committed(root, MARKER_REL, "TEST marker")
    left = [m for m in marker["models"] if m not in session.evaluated]
    if left:
        raise _refuse("models not evaluated on TEST: %s" % left)
    check_commit_preconditions(root, "the TEST result")
    path = root / RESULT_REL
    path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(result, session_id=session.session_id, marker_commit=session.marker_commit),
                               ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    head = commit_paths(root, [RESULT_REL], "metrix: E1-PILOT TEST evaluation result (section 8 step 8)",
                        "the TEST result", retries, sleep)
    del _LIVE[session.session_id]
    return head

# Mythos 项目宪章 v2.0(2026-11-08)

**本文件取代宪章 v1.0。** 与 v1.0、旧 checkpoint 或旧 PROTOCOL 文件冲突时,以本文件和 `research/mini_mythos/PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 为准。历史文件保留不改,但不再约束新工作。

## 1. 方向

- 底座是 Parcae-140M 预训练权重(`SandyResearch/parcae-140m@236739ce`)。我们不再从随机初始化训练自己的权重。
- 最终的 Mythos 是 **Parcae 的派生模型**(Parcae 权重 + 我们的机制/适配器),不是独立权重。Parcae 权重和分词器的许可证未确认,确认前不对外分发任何权重或派生模型。
- 目标:用实验证明“Parcae + 机制”优于原生 Parcae,即同等计算下质量更高,或相近质量下计算更少。不宣称复刻 Claude Mythos。

## 2. 分工与关闭

| 角色 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| 项目负责人 | 定方向、定预算、批准进入下一阶段、宣布 CLOSED |
| Claude Project(策略) | 设计和审核实验方案、解读结果 |
| Claude Code(执行) | 写代码、测试、运行、提交结果和 checkpoint |

不再要求 ChatGPT 或 Grok 交叉审核。阶段由负责人在看过结果后宣布 CLOSED。

## 3. 每个实验的最低要求

1. 一页方案,写在实验目录的 `README.md`:目的、数据、对照、主指标、通过标准、算力和时间上限、停止条件。
2. 方案提交后再运行;看到结果后不改通过标准。
3. 状态如实标注:PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED。负结果也是结果。
4. **同预算对照**:可训练参数量相同、训练 token 数相同、学习率等超参搜索次数相同。只有优于这个对照,才算机制有效。
5. **新数据**:主结论必须来自训练和调参都没用过的数据,至少包含一个异领域集;并抽样检查它与预训练语料的 n-gram 重叠。
6. 每次只加一个机制;组合要等单项都在新数据上通过。
7. 评测输入与预训练一致:**不加 BOS/EOS**,窗口从文档开头取。Parcae 预训练(`pqds-pure` + best-fit 打包)不加任何特殊 token,实测加 BOS 会明显变差(见 `research/mini_mythos/stage0/STAGE0_REVIEW.md`)。BOS 只作对照。

## 4. 流程要轻

- 证据保留到“别人能复核”为止:代码 commit、配置、数据锁定文件(版本 + sha256)、随机种子、汇总结果、每样本结果。大文件留在运行机器上,不进 Git。
- 不对历史文件做逐个哈希保护;不为每个实验重写启动器和守卫。
- 允许中断后续跑,只要配置不变且如实记录。修了 bug 可以重跑,但要在 checkpoint 里写明原因和前后差异。
- 路径或导入类问题 30 分钟内修不好,就停下报告;算力超过方案上限,就停下报告进度。
- checkpoint 一页以内:做了什么、结果、commit SHA、未解决问题、下一步。

## 5. 不要做

- 不修改上游 Parcae(`sandyresearch/parcae@69284c13`,只读)。
- 不操作 PR #24(D1 Draft,保留不合并)。
- 不把开发集上的收益写成“机制有效”。
- 不在方案外使用 GPU;GPU 租用由负责人批准。

## 6. Metrix 子项目(2026-11-13 负责人决定)

Metrix 是独立子项目,不属于 Mythos 方向。`metrix/` 下的工作以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准:

- 本宪章第 1 节(Parcae 底座、派生模型目标)和第 3.7 节(不加 BOS/EOS)**不适用于 Metrix**。Metrix 使用 Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B,打分按其 chat template 构造输入。
- 第 5 节「不要做」的各条继续适用于 Metrix。
- 其余条款与 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 冲突时,在 `metrix/` 内以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准。

@metrix/CLAUDE.md

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

"""ic7_04 trace plugin (implementation stage C, C2 work commit, round 1; task 4, dynamic part). Data Auditor's own code.

A pytest plugin loaded with `-p ic7_04_trace_plugin` while the Executor's test
tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once runs as a driver subprocess (C1 ruling item 5). It does not
check anything: it only records, in the JSONL file named by the environment variable IC7_TRACE, every call (enter /
return / raise) of the functions on the TEST evaluation path, so that my own analysis script (ic7_04_e2e.py, which
imports nothing of the Executor) can compare the observed order with the order I expected before the run. The wrappers
pass arguments and results through unchanged.

Observed (module attribute replaced by a pass-through wrapper after collection, before the fixture runs):
  metrix_e1.pilot.run_test_evaluate, metrix_e1.pilot.test_evaluate, metrix_e1.pilot.final_record,
  metrix_e1.test_data.check_preconditions, metrix_e1.frozen.file_sha256 (only paths ending in .pt are logged),
  metrix_e1.testgate.begin_test_evaluation, metrix_e1.testgate.claim_checkpoint, metrix_e1.testgate.commit_paths,
  metrix_e1.testgate.finish_test_evaluation, metrix_e1.evaluate.evaluate_model, metrix_e1.gate.compute_test_values,
  metrix_e1.gate.judge_test, metrix_e1.gate.report_comparisons.
At the start of the test call (after the fixture) the plugin logs the clone, the bare remote, the work directory, the
models of the fixture and the remote's tip; nothing of the test's objects is changed.

Fault injection (IC7_FAULT, empty by default): "stop_after_marker" raises a ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", ...) and
"crash_after_marker" a RuntimeError when evaluate_model(split="test") is entered for the 3rd time (after the marker was
pushed and two models were evaluated). Used only for the two extra runs that observe the record written (or not) after
the marker; the test is then expected to fail, and only the repository state it leaves is analysed.
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC7_TRACE")
FAULT = os.environ.get("IC7_FAULT", "")
_STATE = {"installed": False, "test_evals": 0, "seq": 0}


def _log(ev):
    _STATE["seq"] += 1
    ev = dict(ev, seq=_STATE["seq"])
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(ev, default=str, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def _short(v):
    s = repr(v)
    return s if len(s) <= 300 else s[:300] + "..."


def _wrap(mod, name, describe=None, result=None, only=None):
    orig = getattr(mod, name)

    def wrapper(*a, **k):
        if only is not None and not only(a, k):
            return orig(*a, **k)
        info = describe(a, k) if describe else {}
        _log(dict({"call": name, "phase": "enter"}, **info))
        if name == "evaluate_model" and k.get("split") == "test":
            _STATE["test_evals"] += 1
            if FAULT and _STATE["test_evals"] == 3:
                if FAULT == "stop_after_marker":
                    from metrix_e1.errors import ProtocolStop
                    exc = ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "auditor-injected stop after the TEST marker (ic7 fault "
                                       "injection, 3rd TEST evaluation)")
                else:
                    exc = RuntimeError("auditor-injected crash after the TEST marker (ic7 fault injection, 3rd TEST "
                                       "evaluation)")
                _log({"call": name, "phase": "injected", "fault": FAULT, "exc": type(exc).__name__})
                raise exc
        try:
            r = orig(*a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:      # noqa: B902 -- logged and re-raised unchanged
            _log({"call": name, "phase": "raise", "exc": type(e).__name__, "msg": str(e)[:400]})
            raise
        _log(dict({"call": name, "phase": "return"}, **(result(r) if result else {})))
        return r
    wrapper.__wrapped_by_ic7__ = orig
    setattr(mod, name, wrapper)


def _install():
    if _STATE["installed"]:
        return
    import metrix_e1.evaluate as E
    import metrix_e1.frozen as FZ
    import metrix_e1.gate as G
    import metrix_e1.pilot as P
    import metrix_e1.test_data as TD
    import metrix_e1.testgate as TG
    _wrap(P, "run_test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r)})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r[0])})
    _wrap(P, "final_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1], "status": a[2]})
    _wrap(TD, "check_preconditions")
    _wrap(FZ, "file_sha256", describe=lambda a, k: {"file": os.path.basename(str(a[0]))}, result=lambda r: {"sha256": r},
          only=lambda a, k: str(a[0]).endswith(".pt"))
    _wrap(TG, "begin_test_evaluation", result=lambda r: {"marker_commit": getattr(r, "marker_commit", None)})
    _wrap(TG, "claim_checkpoint", describe=lambda a, k: {"checkpoint": a[1]})
    _wrap(TG, "commit_paths", describe=lambda a, k: {"rels": list(a[1])}, result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(TG, "finish_test_evaluation", result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(E, "evaluate_model", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": k.get("split", "dev"),
                                                      "checkpoint": k.get("checkpoint_name")})
    _wrap(G, "compute_test_values")
    _wrap(G, "judge_test", result=lambda r: {"final_status": r.get("final_status")})
    _wrap(G, "report_comparisons", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": a[2] if len(a) > 2 else k.get("split")})
    _STATE["installed"] = True
    _log({"call": "plugin", "phase": "installed", "fault": FAULT})


def pytest_collection_finish(session):
    _install()


def pytest_runtest_call(item):
    c = item.funcargs.get("eval_clone")
    if c is None:
        return
    tip = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(c["remote"]), "rev-parse", "main"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    _log({"call": "test", "phase": "start", "root": str(c["root"]), "remote": str(c["remote"]),
          "work": str(c["p"].work), "models": list(c["models"]), "remote_tip_after_fixture": tip,
          "synthetic_question_example": "Synthetic question 0 (not a TEST row)?"})

the clone, the bare remote and the work directory stay for my analysis. My expectations are printed BEFORE the run;

                      TestAlreadyEvaluated.

                      that the experiment record IS written, committed and pushed after the marker (the test then
                      fails at its own assertion; only the state is analysed).
  crash_after_marker  the plugin raises a RuntimeError at the 3rd evaluate_model(split="test"): my reading of

usage: python -I -B ic7_04_e2e.py <repo_root> <venv_python> <inputs_dir> <scratch_dir (created, must not exist)> <mode>

import os

def git(d, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(d), *args], capture_output=True, text=True,
                       env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))

def my_models():

    for arm in ("S", "Y"):

def walk_keys(obj, out):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):

PROTOCOL_FROZEN, the frozen-commit manifests and the smoke's records step1_record.json (file_hashes, content_hashes)
and step1_manifest_fields.json (the fields formal step 1 would write into the two manifests).
  A. PROTOCOL_FROZEN read by my own method (current-version section, frozen commit, table "全部数据哈希"): the four
     content rows and the template-set row, each value equal to the frozen-commit manifest location it names.
  B. the four content hashes from <smoke>/data by the protocol rules (section 0 canonical JSON / JSONL; facts: the six
     fields of every line in file order, as a JSON list; train_S: JSONL; candidates: the object; anchor texts: JSON
     list of the 512 texts in document order, also from my own decode of the stored ids with the pinned Qwen
     tokenizer -- tokenizer only).
  C. the 8 files: byte_sha256 (file bytes) and canonical_sha256 (parsed, re-serialized: JSONL one canonical object per
     line joined by \\n with a final \\n; JSON the canonical object), against step1_record.json file_hashes, my stage-B
     record (audit/stdout/impl_b/36_id_compare.txt) and the Executor's data regeneration of this round
     (<scratch>/c2_data, c2_05_checks.txt listing): byte-identical files.
  D. step1_manifest_fields.json against MY construction of the two fields: frozen DATA_MANIFEST.json "files" with each
     of the 8 non-TEST entries given status GENERATED, byte_sha256, canonical_sha256 (my values) and every other key
     and the two TEST entries unchanged; frozen SPLIT_MANIFEST.json "split_sha256" with each non-TEST name set to my
     canonical_sha256 (B3 ruling note: train_Y.jsonl among them) and test_qa.jsonl left null. The manifests in the
     working tree and index are the frozen ones (smoke does not write them).
  E. templates (SPLIT_MANIFEST normalization rule): normalized text and normalized_sha256 of all 32 templates,
     template_set_sha256 = sha256 of the sorted normalized_sha256 values joined by \\n (template text only; no TEST row).
  F. the data directory listing: the 8 files + LABEL.txt (SMOKE label), no TEST file.
Data Auditor's own script; no Executor code imported, called or copied.
usage: python -I -B ic7_01_hashes.py <repo_root> <qwen_tok_dir> <smoke_work_dir> <executor_c2_data_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import copy
import json
import re
from ia_common import FROZEN, git, blob, sha, canon, jsonl_bytes, read_jsonl, load_qwen, run

PF = "metrix/e1-pilot/PROTOCOL_FROZEN"
FACT_FIELDS = ["fact_id", "exposure", "relation", "stratum", "entity", "answer"]
DATA = ["facts.jsonl", "train_F.jsonl", "train_S.jsonl", "train_Y.jsonl", "dev_qa.jsonl", "candidates.json",
        "general_dev.jsonl", "anchor_text.jsonl"]
TEST_FILES = ["test_qa.jsonl", "general_test.jsonl"]
MY_ROWS = {"facts": "fact(160 条)", "train_S": "`train_S.jsonl`", "candidates": "`candidates.json`",
           "anchor_texts": "锚文本(512 篇解码文本)", "template_set": "模板集合(32 个)"}
KEYS = ["facts", "train_S", "candidates", "anchor_texts"]
DM, SM = "metrix/e1-pilot/DATA_MANIFEST.json", "metrix/e1-pilot/SPLIT_MANIFEST.json"
SMOKE_LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def cells(line):
    return [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]


def normalize(text):
    s = text.replace("{E}", "<ENTITY>").replace("{A}", "<ANSWER>").lower()
    s = "".join(c if c in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789<> " else " " for c in s)
    return re.sub(r" {2,}", " ", s).strip(" ")


def canonical_of(path):
    raw = open(path, "rb").read()
    if path.endswith(".json"):
        return sha(canon(json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))))
    return sha(jsonl_bytes([json.loads(x) for x in raw.decode("utf-8").split("\n") if x != ""]))


def main():
    repo, qdir, work, c2data = sys.argv[1:5]
    dd, rec_d = os.path.join(work, "data"), os.path.join(work, "records")
    ok = True
    print("== A. PROTOCOL_FROZEN, my own reading")
    wt = open(os.path.join(repo, PF), "rb").read()
    print("%s sha256 %s | == HEAD blob %s | == index blob %s" % (PF, sha(wt), wt == blob(repo, "HEAD", PF),
                                                               wt == git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + PF).stdout))
    lines = wt.decode("utf-8").split("\n")
    ver = [ln.split("：", 1)[1].strip() for ln in lines if ln.startswith("当前有效版本：")]
    s0 = lines.index("## %s(当前有效)" % ver[0])
    s1 = next(i for i in range(s0 + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("## "))
    crow = [cells(ln) for ln in lines[s0:s1] if ln.startswith("|") and cells(ln)[0] == "%s 冻结提交(完整 hash)" % ver[0]]
    commit = crow[0][1].strip("`")
    print("current version %s | frozen commit %s | == %s: %s" % (ver, commit, FROZEN, commit == FROZEN))
    ok &= ver == ["v1.1"] and commit == FROZEN
    th = lines.index("### 全部数据哈希")
    table, prev = {}, None
    for ln in lines[th + 1:]:
        if ln.startswith("#"):
            break
        if ln.startswith("|"):
            c = cells(ln)
            if re.fullmatch(r"`[0-9a-f]{64}`", c[1]):
                where = prev if c[3] == "同上" else c[3].strip("`")
                prev = where
                table[c[0]] = (c[1].strip("`"), where)
    print("table rows with a 64-hex value: %d" % len(table))
    ok &= len(table) == 12
    frozen_vals = {}
    for k, label in MY_ROWS.items():
        v, where = table[label]
        fname, path = where.split(": ", 1)
        x = json.loads(blob(repo, FROZEN, "metrix/e1-pilot/" + fname))
        for part in path.split("."):
            x = x[part]
        print("  %-12s row %r -> %s | frozen-commit %s: %s == value: %s" % (k, label, v, fname, path, x == v))
        ok &= x == v
        frozen_vals[k] = v

    print("\n== B. the four content hashes recomputed from %s" % dd)
    raw = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "facts.jsonl"))
    six = all(sorted(r) == sorted(FACT_FIELDS) for r in raw)
    facts = [{f: r[f] for f in FACT_FIELDS} for r in raw]
    s_rows = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "train_S.jsonl"))
    cands = json.load(open(os.path.join(dd, "candidates.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    anchor = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "anchor_text.jsonl"))
    order = [r["doc"] for r in anchor] == list(range(len(anchor)))
    print("facts.jsonl %d lines (each exactly the 6 fields: %s) | train_S.jsonl %d | candidates.json %d facts | "
          "anchor_text.jsonl %d (doc == line index: %s)" % (len(raw), six, len(s_rows), len(cands), len(anchor), order))
    ok &= six and order and len(raw) == 160 and len(s_rows) == 120 and len(cands) == 160 and len(anchor) == 512
    tok = load_qwen(qdir)
    dec = [tok.decode(r["ids"]) for r in anchor]
    mine = {"facts": sha(canon(facts)), "train_S": sha(jsonl_bytes(s_rows)), "candidates": sha(canon(cands)),
            "anchor_texts": sha(canon([r["text"] for r in anchor]))}
    print("anchor texts from my decode of the stored ids: %s | decoded == stored text for all 512: %s" % (
        sha(canon(dec)), dec == [r["text"] for r in anchor]))

    s1rec = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec_d, "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    for k in KEYS:
        same = mine[k] == frozen_vals[k] == s1rec["content_hashes"].get(k)
        print("  %-12s mine %s | PROTOCOL_FROZEN %s | smoke step1_record content_hashes %s | ALL EQUAL %s" % (

    rec3 = {m[0]: (m[1], m[2]) for m in re.findall(r"^  (\S+): rows \d+ \| byte ([0-9a-f]{64}) \| canonical ([0-9a-f]{64})", r3, re.M)}
    ex = open(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_05_checks.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    exl = {m[0]: (m[1], m[2]) for m in re.findall(r"^(\S+)\s+rows\s+\d+\s+byte_sha256 ([0-9a-f]{64})\s+canonical_sha256 ([0-9a-f]{64})", ex, re.M)}
    fh = s1rec["file_hashes"]
    my_files = {}

        b, c = sha(open(p, "rb").read()), canonical_of(p)
        my_files[n] = {"byte_sha256": b, "canonical_sha256": c}

        eq = (fh.get(n) == my_files[n] and rec3.get(n) == (b, c) and exl.get(n) == (b, c) and same_c2)
        print("  %-18s byte %s canonical %s | step1_record %s | my stage-B %s | Executor c2_05 listing %s | == c2_data "

"""ic7_05 (implementation stage C, C2 work commit (staged tree b80c9062, parent f8139f9), round 1; task 5): the 30
training runs of the smoke test.
  A. The training plan derived by me from the frozen SEARCH_SPACE.json (protocol section 7): F, L, A each 6 configs
     with the search seed; the selection on DEV recomputed by me from the per-question DEV details (records/details)
     -- correct(f, q) = 1[score of the true answer > every other candidate's score] (a tie is wrong), Score(f) = mean
     over the fact's DEV questions, Acc(learned) = mean over the 120 learned facts (facts.jsonl), dNLL = mean over
     domains of the mean over windows of NLL_run(w) - NLL_N(w) (N's DEV details) -- by the frozen rule: highest Acc,
     then lower dNLL, then lower learning rate, then lower config index; then F, L, A with the selected config and the
     two other training seeds, S and Y with F's config and the three seeds. Run names "<arm>-<config>-seed<seed>".
     Compared with the smoke's step4/step5 selections and rows, the step6 training_plan / runs_completed, the 30
     records under records/training_runs and the 30 checkpoint files.
  B. Every record: kind training_run, mode smoke, label, arm / config_id / config / seed / phase consistent with the
     name and SEARCH_SPACE.json, finite, steps_run == mode_steps == 3 (smoke --steps 3), contract_steps == the frozen
     total_steps; my Acc(learned) and dNLL equal to the record's dev.acc_dev_learned and dnll.
  C. Checkpoints (file bytes only -- never loaded; torch is not imported by this script): sha256 of
     checkpoints/<run>.pt == record checkpoint.file_sha256, size == file_bytes, file == "<run>.pt";
     state_sha256 == reloaded_state_sha256 in all 30 records; the 30 state hashes distinct and different from N's;
     smoke_report.json trainings: 30 completed, steps_run 3, state_sha256 equal to the records; the checkpoint
     directory holds exactly the 30 files + LABEL.txt (SMOKE label).
  D. G0.8 (informational recomputation): the second evaluation of F's selected config (details/*_dev_g08.json) against
     the first: max |score difference| over QA and closed-book items, prediction differences, max |NLL difference|,
     compared with step7_record values G0.8.
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic7_05_trainings.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from fractions import Fraction
from ia_common import file_sha, frozen_json, read_jsonl, run

SMOKE_LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def load(p):
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))


def correct(item):
    sc, a = item["scores"], item["answer_index"]
    return all(sc[a] > s for i, s in enumerate(sc) if i != a)


def acc_learned(details, learned):
    per = defaultdict(list)
    for q in details["evaluation"]["dev_qa"]:
        per[q["fact_id"]].append(1 if correct(q) else 0)
    score = {f: Fraction(sum(v), len(v)) for f, v in per.items()}
    flags_ok = all(q["correct"] == correct(q) for q in details["evaluation"]["dev_qa"])
    return sum(score[f] for f in learned) / len(learned), flags_ok, {f: len(v) for f, v in per.items()}


def dnll(details, n_rows):
    base = {r["doc_id"]: r for r in n_rows}
    by_dom = defaultdict(list)
    for r in details["evaluation"]["general_dev"]:
        b = base[r["doc_id"]]
        assert b["domain"] == r["domain"] and b["n_w"] == r["n_w"]
        by_dom[r["domain"]].append(r["nll"] - b["nll"])
    return sum(sum(v) / len(v) for v in by_dom.values()) / len(by_dom), {d: len(v) for d, v in by_dom.items()}


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    rec, ck = os.path.join(work, "records"), os.path.join(work, "checkpoints")
    ok = True
    ss = frozen_json(repo, "SEARCH_SPACE.json")
    seeds, search_seed = ss["training_contract"]["training_seeds"], ss["search_seed"]
    total = ss["training_contract"]["total_steps"]
    facts = read_jsonl(os.path.join(work, "data", "facts.jsonl"))
    learned = [f["fact_id"] for f in facts if f["exposure"] == "learned"]
    print("frozen SEARCH_SPACE: seeds %s search seed %s total_steps %s counts %s | inherits S %r Y %r" % (
        seeds, search_seed, total, ss["counts"], ss["arms"]["S"]["inherits"], ss["arms"]["Y"]["inherits"]))
    n_det = load(os.path.join(rec, "details", "N_dev.json"))
    n_rows = n_det["evaluation"]["general_dev"]

    print("\n== A. selection recomputed from the DEV details")
    mine_acc, mine_dnll, selected = {}, {}, {}
    for arm in ("F", "L", "A"):
        rows = []
        for i, c in enumerate(ss["arms"][arm]["configs"]):
            name = "%s-%s-seed%d" % (arm, c["id"], search_seed)
            det = load(os.path.join(rec, "details", "%s_dev.json" % name))
            a, flags_ok, nq = acc_learned(det, learned)
            d, nd = dnll(det, n_rows)

"""ic7_03 (implementation stage C, C2 work commit (staged tree b80c9062, parent f8139f9), round 1; task 3): the smoke
produced no TEST content, and the TEST generator refuses in the current state (black box).
  A. <smoke> (the smoke's work directory): no file named test_qa.jsonl or general_test.jsonl anywhere under it (names
     only, nothing is opened); the step 8 out directory the smoke used does not exist.
  B. records/step8_record.json: the command is the generator module (python -m metrix_e1.test_data) with --data the
     smoke's data directory and --out under <smoke>; non-zero return code, last stdout line RESULT: FAIL, the refusal
     line present, --out not created, no TEST file under <smoke>, refused true, SMOKE label.
  C. My own run of the generator, once, as a black-box subprocess, the way run_pilot.py runs it (cwd the repository
     root, PYTHONPATH the package's src directory, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1):
         <venv python> -m metrix_e1.test_data --inputs <inputs> --data <smoke>/data --out <out_dir>
     <out_dir> does not exist and lies outside the repository. Expected (written before the run): every
     interpretation is ruled and HEAD has no Gate 0 record (metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json is neither in
     HEAD nor in the working tree), so condition 2 fails first: stdout exactly
         TEST generator refused: metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json is not committed at HEAD
         no TEST content was generated, read or written
         RESULT: FAIL
     exit code 1, the same three lines as the smoke's step 8 and as c2_05_checks.txt; <out_dir> not created. The
     process is killed at once if a line only a generating run prints appears.
     After: data directory, inputs, src tree and `git status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all -- metrix`
     (audit/ excluded: my outputs are written there) unchanged; no results directory; no ST10 record in the working
     tree or in any commit.
Data Auditor's own script; the Executor's module is only executed as the black-box command.
usage: python -I -B ic7_03_test_refusal.py <repo_root> <venv_python> <inputs_dir> <smoke_work_dir> <out_dir (must not exist)>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from ia_common import file_sha, run

GEN_MARKERS = ("byte_sha256", "TEST part value", "TEST part count", "L6 TEST count", "leakage_test_report",
               "ST10 record written", "ST10:")
EXPECTED = ["TEST generator refused: metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json is not committed at HEAD",
            "no TEST content was generated, read or written", "RESULT: FAIL"]
TEST_NAMES = ("test_qa.jsonl", "general_test.jsonl")


def git(repo, *args, check=True):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *args], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    if check and r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed: %r" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r


def tree_snapshot(root):
    out = {}
    for r, ds, fs in os.walk(root):
        for f in fs:
            p = os.path.join(r, f)
            st = os.stat(p)
            out[os.path.relpath(p, root)] = (st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns, file_sha(p))
    return out


def main():
    repo, py, inputs, work, out = sys.argv[1:6]
    data = os.path.join(work, "data")
    ok = True
    print("== A. no TEST file under the smoke's work directory (names only)")
    hits = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(work) for f in fs if f in TEST_NAMES]
    nfiles = sum(len(fs) for _, _, fs in os.walk(work))
    print("files under %s: %d | named test_qa.jsonl / general_test.jsonl: %s" % (work, nfiles, hits))
    ok &= not hits
    s8out = os.path.join(work, "step8_refused_out")
    print("smoke step 8 --out %s exists: %s" % (s8out, os.path.exists(s8out)))
    ok &= not os.path.exists(s8out)

    print("\n== B. records/step8_record.json")
    s8 = json.load(open(os.path.join(work, "records", "step8_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    cmd8 = s8["command"]
    lines8 = s8["stdout"].rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    print("command %s" % cmd8)
    c_ok = (cmd8[1:3] == ["-m", "metrix_e1.test_data"] and cmd8[cmd8.index("--data") + 1] == data
            and cmd8[cmd8.index("--out") + 1] == s8out)
    print("generator module, --data the smoke data dir, --out under the work dir: %s" % c_ok)
    print("returncode %r | stdout lines %s | stderr %r | out_exists %r | test_files_under_work %r | refused %r | mode %r "
          "label %r" % (s8["returncode"], lines8, s8["stderr"], s8["out_exists"], s8["test_files_under_work"], s8["refused"],
                        s8["mode"], s8["label"]))
    b_ok = (c_ok and s8["returncode"] != 0 and lines8 == EXPECTED and s8["out_exists"] is False
            and s8["test_files_under_work"] == [] and s8["refused"] is True and s8["mode"] == "smoke"
            and s8["label"] == "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT")
    print("step 8 record shows the refusal (stdout == my expected three lines): %s" % b_ok)
    ok &= b_ok

    print("\n== C. my black-box run of the TEST generator")
    print("out_dir %s exists: %s" % (out, os.path.exists(out)))
    ok &= not os.path.exists(out)
    ro, oo = os.path.realpath(repo), os.path.realpath(out)
    outside = not (oo == ro or oo.startswith(ro + os.sep))
    print("out_dir outside the repository %s: %s" % (ro, outside))
    ok &= outside
    g0 = "metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json"
    in_head = git(repo, "cat-file", "-e", "HEAD:%s" % g0, check=False).returncode == 0
    in_idx = git(repo, "cat-file", "-e", ":%s" % g0, check=False).returncode == 0
    in_wt = os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, g0))
    print("%s: in HEAD %s | in the index %s | in the working tree %s" % (g0, in_head, in_idx, in_wt))
    if in_head or in_wt or in_idx:
        print("precondition 2 could hold: the generator is NOT run")
        return False
    print("expected stdout (before the run): %s ; exit code 1" % EXPECTED)
    src = os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/src")
    data_before, inputs_before, src_before = tree_snapshot(data), tree_snapshot(inputs), tree_snapshot(src)
    gs_args = ("status", "--porcelain", "--ignored", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "metrix", ":(exclude)metrix/e1-pilot/audit")
    gs_before = git(repo, *gs_args).stdout.decode()
    print("data dir files: %s | files under src: %d | files under inputs: %d" % (sorted(data_before), len(src_before),
                                                                                len(inputs_before)))
    cmd = [py, "-m", "metrix_e1.test_data", "--inputs", inputs, "--data", data, "--out", out]
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", PYTHONPATH=src)
    print("cwd %s | PYTHONPATH %s" % (repo, src))
    print("$ " + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
    print("----- generator stdout+stderr begin -----")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1)
    lines, killed = [], False
    for line in p.stdout:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        lines.append(line)
        print(line)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        if any(m in line for m in GEN_MARKERS):
            p.kill()
            killed = True
            print("!!! generation output seen: process killed")
            break
    rc = p.wait()
    print("----- generator stdout+stderr end -----")
    print("exit code %d | killed by the auditor %s" % (rc, killed))
    same = not killed and rc == 1 and lines == EXPECTED
    print("output == my expected three lines and exit 1: %s | == the smoke's step 8 stdout: %s" % (same, lines == lines8))
    ok &= same and lines == lines8
    exl = [ln for ln in open(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_05_checks.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
           if ln.startswith("TEST generator refused:")]
    print("refusal line == the Executor's in c2_05_checks.txt %s: %s" % (exl, [lines[0]] == exl))
    ok &= [lines[0]] == exl

    print("\n== after")
    print("out_dir %s exists: %s" % (out, os.path.exists(out)))
    ok &= not os.path.exists(out)
    data_after, inputs_after, src_after = tree_snapshot(data), tree_snapshot(inputs), tree_snapshot(src)
    gs_after = git(repo, *gs_args).stdout.decode()
    print("data dir unchanged (names, sizes, mtimes, sha256): %s | TEST file names in it: %s" % (
        data_after == data_before, [n for n in TEST_NAMES if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, n))]))
    ok &= data_after == data_before and not any(os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, n)) for n in TEST_NAMES)
    print("inputs unchanged: %s | src tree unchanged: %s | git status (audit/ excluded) unchanged: %s" % (
        inputs_after == inputs_before, src_after == src_before, gs_after == gs_before))
    ok &= inputs_after == inputs_before and src_after == src_before and gs_after == gs_before
    print("results directory exists: %s" % os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/results")))
    ok &= not os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/results"))
    st10 = "metrix/e1-pilot/results/st10_record.json"
    st10_any = os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, st10)) or git(repo, "log", "--all", "--full-history", "--format=%H", "--", st10).stdout.strip() != b""
    print("%s in the working tree or in any commit: %s" % (st10, st10_any))
    ok &= not st10_any
    hits2 = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(work) for f in fs if f in TEST_NAMES]
    print("TEST file names under the smoke work dir after the run: %s" % hits2)
    ok &= not hits2
    return bool(ok)


run(main)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from ia_common import file_sha, run

GEN_MARKERS = ("byte_sha256", "TEST part value", "TEST part count", "L6 TEST count", "leakage_test_report",
               "ST10 record written", "ST10:")
EXPECTED = ["TEST generator refused: metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json is not committed at HEAD",
            "no TEST content was generated, read or written", "RESULT: FAIL"]
TEST_NAMES = ("test_qa.jsonl", "general_test.jsonl")


def git(repo, *args, check=True):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *args], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    if check and r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed: %r" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r


def tree_snapshot(root):
    out = {}
    for r, ds, fs in os.walk(root):
        for f in fs:
            p = os.path.join(r, f)
            st = os.stat(p)
            out[os.path.relpath(p, root)] = (st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns, file_sha(p))
    return out

    hits = [os.path.join(d, f) for d, _, fs in os.walk(work) for f in fs if f in TEST_NAMES]

    print("returncode %r | stdout lines %s | stderr %r | out_exists %r | test_files_under_work %r | refused %r | mode %r "
          "label %r" % (s8["returncode"], lines8, s8["stderr"], s8["out_exists"], s8["test_files_under_work"], s8["refused"],
                        s8["mode"], s8["label"]))

            and s8["test_files_under_work"] == [] and s8["refused"] is True and s8["mode"] == "smoke"
            and s8["label"] == "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT")
    print("step 8 record shows the refusal (stdout == my expected three lines): %s" % b_ok)

    print("\n== C. my black-box run of the TEST generator")

    ok &= outside
    g0 = "metrix/e1-pilot/results/gate0_record.json"
    in_head = git(repo, "cat-file", "-e", "HEAD:%s" % g0, check=False).returncode == 0
    in_idx = git(repo, "cat-file", "-e", ":%s" % g0, check=False).returncode == 0
    in_wt = os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, g0))
    print("%s: in HEAD %s | in the index %s | in the working tree %s" % (g0, in_head, in_idx, in_wt))
    if in_head or in_wt or in_idx:
        print("precondition 2 could hold: the generator is NOT run")
        return False
    print("expected stdout (before the run): %s ; exit code 1" % EXPECTED)
    src = os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/src")

    gs_args = ("status", "--porcelain", "--ignored", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "metrix", ":(exclude)metrix/e1-pilot/audit")
    gs_before = git(repo, *gs_args).stdout.decode()
    print("data dir files: %s | files under src: %d | files under inputs: %d" % (sorted(data_before), len(src_before),
                                                                                len(inputs_before)))
    cmd = [py, "-m", "metrix_e1.test_data", "--inputs", inputs, "--data", data, "--out", out]
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", PYTHONPATH=src)

    print("$ " + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
    print("----- generator stdout+stderr begin -----")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1)
    lines, killed = [], False
    for line in p.stdout:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        lines.append(line)

        sys.stdout.flush()
        if any(m in line for m in GEN_MARKERS):
            p.kill()

            print("!!! generation output seen: process killed")
            break
    rc = p.wait()
    print("----- generator stdout+stderr end -----")
    print("exit code %d | killed by the auditor %s" % (rc, killed))
    same = not killed and rc == 1 and lines == EXPECTED
    print("output == my expected three lines and exit 1: %s | == the smoke's step 8 stdout: %s" % (same, lines == lines8))
    ok &= same and lines == lines8
    exl = [ln for ln in open(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_05_checks.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
           if ln.startswith("TEST generator refused:")]
    print("refusal line == the Executor's in c2_05_checks.txt %s: %s" % (exl, [lines[0]] == exl))
    ok &= [lines[0]] == exl

    print("\n== after")
    print("out_dir %s exists: %s" % (out, os.path.exists(out)))
    ok &= not os.path.exists(out)
    data_after, inputs_after, src_after = tree_snapshot(data), tree_snapshot(inputs), tree_snapshot(src)

    print("results directory exists: %s" % os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/results")))

    print("TEST file names under the smoke work dir after the run: %s" % hits2)
    ok &= not hits2
    return bool(ok)

"""ic7_06 (implementation stage C, C2 work commit (staged tree b80c9062, parent f8139f9), round 1; supplementary to tasks
1-5): the smoke outputs are labelled and carry no Gate 0 conclusion (Implementation Task Order V1 section 7).
  - every JSON file under <smoke>/records (step, run, details, Gate 0, smoke report, experiment record) has
    label "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT" and mode "smoke"; every .txt record starts with the label line; data/, checkpoints/,
    preflight/ each hold LABEL.txt with the label;
  - gate0_record: gate0_status NOT_TESTED with the note 冒烟测试，不构成结论, all ten conditions G0.1-G0.10 computed;
    experiment record Status NOT_TESTED; "smoke: device check skipped" recorded (step 1 record, smoke report);
  - the smoke's recorded "would stop" entries are exactly the value stops whose condition holds by the recorded values:
    ST3 (positive control: Acc_CB below the ST3 bound or Acc(F, DEV-QA, learned) below it; bounds read from the frozen
    protocol's ST3 / G0.4 / G0.5 text), ST11 (preflight estimate above the ST11 hours of the frozen protocol), and not
    ST2 / ST4 / ST5 (G0.3, G0.7, G0.6 satisfied in the smoke Gate 0 record).
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic7_06_smoke_labels.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from ia_common import frozen_protocol, run

LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    rec = os.path.join(work, "records")
    ok = True
    js, txt = [], []
    for d, _, fs in os.walk(rec):
        for f in fs:
            (js if f.endswith(".json") else txt).append(os.path.join(d, f))
    bad = []
    for p in js:
        o = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        if o.get("label") != LABEL or o.get("mode") != "smoke":
            bad.append((os.path.relpath(p, rec), o.get("label"), o.get("mode")))
    badt = [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt if open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")[0] != LABEL]
    print("JSON records %d, without the SMOKE label or mode smoke: %s | text records %d %s, first line not the label: %s" % (
        len(js), bad, len(txt), [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt], badt))
    ok &= not bad and not badt and len(js) > 0
    for d in ("data", "checkpoints", "preflight"):
        lab = open(os.path.join(work, d, "LABEL.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        print("  %s/LABEL.txt %r" % (d, lab))
        ok &= lab == LABEL + "\n"
    g0 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "gate0_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["gate0"]
    conds = sorted(g0["conditions"], key=lambda c: int(c.split(".")[1]))
    print("gate0_status %r note %r | conditions %s" % (g0["gate0_status"], g0.get("note"), conds))
    ok &= g0["gate0_status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and g0.get("note") == "冒烟测试，不构成结论" and conds == ["G0.%d" % i for i in range(1, 11)]
    ex = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "experiment_record_smoke.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["template"]
    print("experiment record Status %r Interpretation %r | template fields %d" % (ex["Status"], ex["Interpretation"], len(ex)))
    ok &= ex["Status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and len(ex) == 20
    s1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sr = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "smoke_report.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    print("device note: step1_record %r | smoke_report %r" % (s1["device"], sr["device_note"]))
    ok &= s1["device"] == "smoke: device check skipped" == sr["device_note"]

    prot = frozen_protocol(repo)
    st3 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST3 |")][0]
    st11 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST11 |")][0]
    cb_min, acc_min = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"< (0\.\d+)", st3)]
    hours = float(re.search(r"超过 ([\d.]+) 小时", st11).group(1))
    print("frozen protocol: %s\n                 %s\n  -> ST3 bounds Acc_CB %s, Acc %s | ST11 hours %s" % (st3, st11, cb_min, acc_min, hours))
    s4 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step4_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["positive_control"]
    pre = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step2_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["preflight"]
    sat = {c: x["satisfied"] for c, x in g0["conditions"].items()}

    preflight/ each hold LABEL.txt with the label;
  - gate0_record: gate0_status NOT_TESTED with the note 冒烟测试，不构成结论, all ten conditions G0.1-G0.10 computed;
    experiment record Status NOT_TESTED; "smoke: device check skipped" recorded (step 1 record, smoke report);
  - the smoke's recorded "would stop" entries are exactly the value stops whose condition holds by the recorded values:
    ST3 (positive control: Acc_CB below the ST3 bound or Acc(F, DEV-QA, learned) below it; bounds read from the frozen
    protocol's ST3 / G0.4 / G0.5 text), ST11 (preflight estimate above the ST11 hours of the frozen protocol), and not
    ST2 / ST4 / ST5 (G0.3, G0.7, G0.6 satisfied in the smoke Gate 0 record).
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic7_06_smoke_labels.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from ia_common import frozen_protocol, run

LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    rec = os.path.join(work, "records")
    ok = True
    js, txt = [], []
    for d, _, fs in os.walk(rec):
        for f in fs:
            (js if f.endswith(".json") else txt).append(os.path.join(d, f))
    bad = []
    for p in js:
        o = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        if o.get("label") != LABEL or o.get("mode") != "smoke":
            bad.append((os.path.relpath(p, rec), o.get("label"), o.get("mode")))
    badt = [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt if open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")[0] != LABEL]
    print("JSON records %d, without the SMOKE label or mode smoke: %s | text records %d %s, first line not the label: %s" % (
        len(js), bad, len(txt), [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt], badt))

    print("experiment record Status %r Interpretation %r | template fields %d" % (ex["Status"], ex["Interpretation"], len(ex)))
    ok &= ex["Status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and len(ex) == 20
    s1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sr = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "smoke_report.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    print("device note: step1_record %r | smoke_report %r" % (s1["device"], sr["device_note"]))
    ok &= s1["device"] == "smoke: device check skipped" == sr["device_note"]

    prot = frozen_protocol(repo)
    st3 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST3 |")][0]
    st11 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST11 |")][0]

    print("frozen protocol: %s\n                 %s\n  -> ST3 bounds Acc_CB %s, Acc %s | ST11 hours %s" % (st3, st11, cb_min, acc_min, hours))
    s4 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step4_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["positive_control"]
    pre = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step2_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["preflight"]
    sat = {c: x["satisfied"] for c, x in g0["conditions"].items()}
    want = sorted((["ST3"] if s4["acc_cb"] < cb_min or s4["acc_dev_learned"] < acc_min else [])
                  + (["ST11"] if pre["estimate_total_hours"] > hours else [])
                  + (["ST2"] if not sat["G0.3"] else []) + (["ST4"] if not sat["G0.7"] else [])
                  + (["ST5"] if not sat["G0.6"] else []))
    got = sorted(x["stop"] for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    print("positive control acc_cb %s acc_dev_learned %s (step4 st3 %r) | preflight estimate %.3f h (step2 st11 %r) | G0.3 %s "
          "G0.6 %s G0.7 %s" % (s4["acc_cb"], s4["acc_dev_learned"], s4["st3"], pre["estimate_total_hours"], pre["st11"],
                               sat["G0.3"], sat["G0.6"], sat["G0.7"]))
    print("recorded 'would stop' %s == expected from the recorded values %s: %s | every entry labelled: %s" % (
        got, want, got == want, all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])))
    ok &= got == want and all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    return bool(ok)
